ownership: Official public business-entity registration records published through the Colorado Information Marketplace
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS Socrata API.
allowed_use: official HTTPS metadata and selected-field API queries
redistribution of approved normalized public fields with source attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing Good Standing as independent proof of current operations, legality, reputation, solvency, public access, licensure, or an open storefront
representing Delinquent as proof that the entity has ceased to exist or ceased operating
representing a principal office address as a verified physical operating site
representing this state registry as every business operating in Colorado or the United States
merging organizations across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: Colorado Department of State (CDOS), Business Entities in Colorado, via the Colorado Information Marketplace.
retention: Indefinite for immutable selected-field source and approved normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved normalized fields may be redistributed with CDOS attribution, source refresh timestamp, source checksum, provenance, field exclusions, and status/address limitations retained; the selected-field raw snapshot remains internal.
personal_data_handling: The connector excludes every registered-agent name and address plus the principal-office mailing address. Organization names and principal-office street addresses can incidentally identify a person or home because they are public registration fields.
